# Third-party browser dependencies

The files in this directory are vendored so the chat page can render Markdown
and mathematical formulas without relying on a public CDN at runtime.

- markdown-it 15.0.0 — MIT License
- DOMPurify 3.4.13 — Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0
- MathJax 4.1.3 — Apache-2.0
- MathJax New Computer Modern font 4.1.3 — Apache-2.0

The corresponding license files and package metadata are stored alongside the
vendored files.
